description: B.Sc. Computer Science graduate with a specialized background in API Development and scalable systems. During my tenure as an API Developer Intern, I mastered the .NET ecosystem, specifically leveraging Dapper for high-performance data access and Entity Framework (EF Core) for robust modeling. I focused heavily on SQL optimization, writing complex Stored Procedures, and refining backend scalability to handle enterprise-level data logic.

Currently, as a Full-Stack Intern at Algo Analytics (Feb – June 2026), I am bridging the gap between high-speed backends and responsive interfaces through live React.js projects. I actively collaborate across teams to deploy full-stack solutions, utilizing Docker for containerization and GitHub for advanced version control and CI/CD workflows.

My technical foundation includes Java (Spring Boot, Hibernate), C# (.NET), and MySQL. From architecting automated scheduling systems to building secure online voting platforms, I leverage a comprehensive stack—including React, JavaScript, and RESTful APIs—to build professional software that scales.
